title: celtis laevigata var. smallii
intro: Celtis laevigata var. smallii, commonly known as Small's hackberry, is a deciduous shrub or small tree native to eastern North America. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include treating fever, sore throats, and rheumatism, due to its health benefits. The plant has been reported to exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Celtis laevigata var. smallii include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids.
